text:
Monica T.: Drafting the internal release note for next Tue's micropatch. Need a concise blurb + exact rollback checklist.
Ethan R.: Call out model-pin behavior explicitly. Don't want autosync to nudge pins during promote.
Monica T.: Plan: canary 15% x 20m -> 60% x 15m -> promote. Start: Tue 05:30 UTC (Mon 22:30 PT). Change window = 60m.
Harper Z.: Also mention the async embedding reindex that runs post-promote (~15-25m). Support should prep a short advisory.
Lydia P.: Rollback thresholds: 5m error rate > 1% OR P95 latency jump > 400ms sustained for 10m OR embedding job failures.
Monica T.: Draft blurb for review:
"Micropatch v2.6.3  rolling canary Tue 05:30 UTC. Fixes: runtime pacing and KV-prefetch resilience. Visible: short embedding reindex after promote. Ops monitoring in place; rollback to v2.6.2 if thresholds breach. Expect transient similarity-search variance during reindex."
Ethan R.: Add: "Do not modify pinned model refs during canary. Verify pins after promote; contact infra@redwood for discrepancies."
Harper Z.: Include deploy snippet so ops can copy it straight to the runbook:
```
/deploy canary v2.6.3 --zone=us-east-1 --steps=15,60,100 --watch --timeout=60m
/deploy rollback v2.6.3 v2.6.2 --reason="ops-threshold"
```
deploy-bot: canary rollout queued by Monica T. for v2.6.3. Track with `/deploy status 9819998888`.
Lydia P.: Rollback checklist for the internal note (keep short):
- `/deploy rollback v2.6.3 v2.6.2`
- disable canary routing
- post status in #incident-announce
- email support@redwood and page @sre-oncall

Monica T.: Links to include in blast:
- Canary playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/canary-playbook
- Evac runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/evac-runbook
- Pin-checks (dry-run): https://wiki.redwood/internal/pinchecks/v2.6.3-dryrun

Ethan R.: Oncall "what to look for": 500 spikes, GPU mem creep, embedding-job duration > 25m, KV miss rate.
Harper Z.: I'll run the dry-run Mon 14:00 UTC and paste the pin-check table here. If mismatch, we push +24h.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance collision check: no overlapping maintenance in target window.
deploy-bot: reminder: run deploy from ops CI with `--watch` to enable automated monitor-based rollback.
Monica T.: Please review and sign off by Mon 20:00 UTC. I'll merge the release notes after approvals and hand to Harper for internal announcement. :thumbsup:
